title: Per-region ecology file (#29) — the species x habitat x area x time join
description: Ecology is the join from which game encounters (#7) and show ambient population (LIVING-WORLD P2) both derive. This format carries NO numbers: weights live in spawn tables, rates nowhere until canon sets them. A resident row requires a canon source in evidence. Display names follow the display sweep (Region 1 displays as Iridescence); production names stay in production docs (two-lane law). S2 Landing 3 (2026-10-30): zone records gain biomeId, environment, authoredLife, neighbours; habitatClasses enum aligned with the spawn schema by Landing 2.

areaId.description: Join to spawn-table files (#7). Null if the zone has no encounter file.

showLocation.description: Show-side location (LIVING-WORLD). Null if no show counterpart is established.

habitatClasses.description: The spawn schema's enum plus the Forest extensions, aligned by S2 Landing 2 (night removed — a time band, not a class; waters-edge/underground/built added).

evidence.description: The canon source that places this species here. No source, no row.

timeBands.description: Presence marks (speciesIds) ONLY where a canon source speaks in time terms (show P6 time truth). Null = canon silent.

status.description: Zone provenance; the Dark Forest depths zone is 'OPEN — canon does not stock the depths' with residents [].

biomeId.description: Join to biomes.json. Null only where no biome grouping is authored yet.

weatherKey.description: WEATHER_CONFIG key (live weather) or null where no weather is authored (interiors/withheld zones).

sceneId.description: Sound-bed scene id; null until S15's environment swap authors it (sceneMap per-map table stays fallback).

authoredLife.description: Derived from residents/status: true where the zone carries authored life (B6 tending legality reads this).

neighbours.description: Neighbouring zoneIds, derived from routes/region1-route-graph.json edges (zone-to-zone only).
